verdict: the pipeline is worse than baseline EVEN WHEN THE ANCHOR IS CORRECT, so no anchor selector can rescue it; break-even anchor accuracy is 243%, which is impossible. The entire oracle gain comes from hand-placing a gold in slot 1 (+16.49 pp), while the expansion itself costs -3.73 pp.
lesson: an intermediate metric can disagree in SIGN with the final metric. Rank movement said query expansion was net +38 golds into the top-10; end-to-end FR@3 says the same mechanism is net negative. Validating a mechanism on an intermediate metric is not enough.
